HT1080:
**a,** lpWGS after two successive CP + Q53 nucleofections, realigned with the Y copies of PAR masked. Grey points show corrected Y-bin copy number as a percentage of sgCTRL; red lines show regional medians. Teal points and lines show combined X/Y PAR coverage mapped to X, normalised to autosomal depth and then sgCTRL. The dashed line marks 100% of sgCTRL. Y bins require ≥60% non-N sequence, ≥30% mappability and ≥50 primary MAPQ ≥37 control reads; PAR bins require ≥20 reads and ≥50 reads per 100 kb. Boundary-crossing Y bins, centromere and Yq12 are excluded; hatching marks the latter two and Yq12 is compressed. PAR1 and PAR2 contain 24 and four bins, respectively. One DNA sample represents each population. The near-zero Yq median is labelled <1%; it does not establish complete absence of Yq DNA.

**Sex-chromosome dosage and expected PAR retention.** Local sgCTRL dosage is consistent with an XY-equivalent model. Complete loss of Y-derived PAR with unchanged X dosage would retain approximately 50% of combined PAR signal (XY → X); partial Y retention can leave signal above this baseline. This dosage inference is not a cytogenetic karyotype.

**b,** HG002 T2T-Y ideogram with RNA-seq genes above and ddPCR target-gene spans below, including AMELY, DDX3Y and KDM5D. Panels a and b share coordinates and Yq12 compression; X-PAR bins in a are projected within the corresponding labelled PAR spans.

**c,** RNA-seq expression normalised to mean sgCTRL expression within each sampling period (circles, August 2025; triangles, May 2026; three passage samples per condition per period). Horizontal marks show six-sample means; the dashed line marks 100% of sgCTRL. Blue denotes sgCTRL and red denotes Y-depleted cells. Teal shading and labels identify PAR genes, whose expression is not Y-specific. Samples derive from one established population per condition.

**a,** lpWGS after two successive CP + Q53 nucleofections, realigned with the Y copies of PAR masked. Grey points show corrected Y-bin copy number as a percentage of sgCTRL; red lines show regional medians. Teal points and lines show combined X/Y PAR coverage mapped to X, normalised to autosomal depth and then sgCTRL. The dashed line marks 100% of sgCTRL. DU145:
**a,** lpWGS after two successive CP + Q53 + P47 nucleofections, realigned with the Y copies of PAR masked. Grey points show corrected Y-bin copy number as a percentage of sgCTRL; red lines show regional medians. Teal points and lines show combined X/Y PAR coverage mapped to X, normalised to autosomal depth and then sgCTRL. The dashed line marks 100% of sgCTRL. Y bins require ≥60% non-N sequence, ≥30% mappability and ≥50 primary MAPQ ≥37 control reads; PAR bins require ≥20 reads and ≥50 reads per 100 kb. Boundary-crossing Y bins, centromere and Yq12 are excluded; hatching marks the latter two and Yq12 is compressed. PAR1 and PAR2 contain 24 and four bins, respectively. One DNA sample represents each population. Distal (~2.46–4.80 Mb) and proximal (~4.80–10.57 Mb) male-specific Yp are summarised separately; the division is not a precise structural breakpoint.

**Sex-chromosome dosage and expected PAR retention.** The reference-stock karyotype comprises one X and a rearranged Y ([ATCC](https://www.atcc.org/products/htb-81)). An intact XY → X model would predict 50% PAR retention. Local X:Yq dosage (approximately 1.8:1) is closer to an XXY-equivalent model, which predicts approximately 67% PAR retention if X dosage is unchanged. Using Yq as the Y-dosage baseline and allowing for the higher X dosage in the depleted pool gives a conditional expectation of approximately 73–74%. Both calculations assume complete loss of Y-derived PAR; bulk lpWGS does not establish the local structural karyotype.

**b,** HG002 T2T-Y ideogram with RNA-seq genes above and ddPCR target-gene spans below, including AMELY, DDX3Y and KDM5D. Panels a and b share coordinates and Yq12 compression; X-PAR bins in a are projected within the corresponding labelled PAR spans.

**c,** RNA-seq expression normalised to mean sgCTRL expression. Points represent three passage samples per condition; horizontal marks show group means. The dashed line marks 100% of sgCTRL. NA denotes undefined relative expression for NLGN4Y because control expression was zero. Blue denotes sgCTRL and red denotes Y-depleted cells. Teal shading and labels identify PAR genes, whose expression is not Y-specific. Samples derive from one established population per condition.
